comparison.objective: Set up a specified chess position from FEN while respecting side-specific arm reachability.
comparison.physical_skill: Symbolic board interpretation, repeated piece grasping, upright placement, and bimanual work allocation.
comparison.success_condition: Eight required pieces are upright within 1 cm of their squares and no extra piece is over the board.
comparison.reason: Tests symbolic parsing and multi-object placement rather than coaxial tool use, impact, fracture, and containment.
